security.title: Security
security.ad_outage_policy: When the domain does not respond
security.policyHint: The portal limit must be stricter than the domain account lockout threshold.

policy.grace: Keep working for a limited time

security.internalHint: One network per line (CIDR). From other addresses an app code is asked from those who set it up and from the roles below. If the portal is behind a proxy, set PULT_TRUSTED_PROXIES.
security.totpRolesHint: These roles can sign in from the internet only with a code set up (Profile → Sign-in from the internet). For everyone else the code is optional.
security.kerberosHint: An employee on a domain PC signs in with “Sign in with domain account” — no password. Organization networks only. Requires a keytab (KRB5_KTNAME) and the SPN HTTP/<portal name> on the service account; the portal must be in the browser’s Local intranet zone. Check it on the Status page.
security.ad_password_change: Domain password change in the profile
security.adPasswordHint: Employees change their own AD password on the My profile page: the portal signs in as them with the old password and changes it; the domain checks its password policy. Requires an LDAPS connection to the domain. A wrong old password counts as a failed sign-in; after the change, sessions on other devices are closed.

mail.dropPassword: Remove the saved password (server without sign-in)

system.localeHint: For new users and for emails to addresses without a portal account. Everyone can switch their own language in the account menu.
system.tlsExternal: HTTPS is configured outside the portal: in the server settings or on a reverse proxy.
system.tlsCertHint: PEM: the server certificate and intermediates. Applied immediately, no restart needed.
system.backupNone: No backups yet. A daily backup runs at 02:30.
system.backupKeepHint: 1 to 365. Extra old copies are removed after the next backup. Keeping copies off the portal server is the job of external storage.
system.pushHint: Employees turn them on in their profile. The server needs Internet access to the browsers' push services (Google, Mozilla, Apple, Microsoft). The content is encrypted with the browser's key: the push service cannot read it.
system.pushShowText: Show the ticket or message subject (visible on the lock screen)
system.pushContactHint: mailto:address or https://… — the push service uses it to reach you about delivery problems.

oidc.title: OpenID Connect sign-in (SSO)
oidc.hint: Keycloak, ADFS, Entra ID and other providers. The provider confirms identity; the account, roles and disabling come from AD, as with password sign-in.
oidc.issuerHint: Settings and keys are read from <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration. https:// only.
oidc.redirectHint: Register this address with the provider: {{url}}
oidc.claimHint: The account is looked up in the AD mirror by this ID token field.

oidc.noKeys: The provider has not published signing keys.
oidc.identitiesHint: On first sign-in the provider’s permanent user ID (sub) is linked to the portal account. Renaming a user at the provider does not give access to someone else’s account. If users were moved to another provider or recreated, reset the links.
oidc.resetConfirm: Reset all links? Each user will be linked again on next sign-in.

assist.title: AI assistant
assist.hint: Your own model on a separate server with an OpenAI-compatible API (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio and others). The assistant answers questions from the knowledge base, suggests a category for new tickets, and writes reply drafts and ticket summaries for engineers. It only advises and does nothing by itself.
assist.urlHint: Without /chat/completions at the end, for example http://llm.example.local:8000/v1.
assist.noKey: Not set: the model server needs no key.
assist.privacy: The model receives the texts of articles and tickets that the user can see. Use a server inside the organization network; with an http:// address the API key is sent in clear text.

import.title: Import from CSV
import.hint: The first row holds headers: name and type are required; inventory_number, serial_number, site, room, responsible (e-mail or AD login), status, notes and the type's fields are optional. Column captions in Russian, English or Chinese work too. Separator: “;” or “,”, encoding UTF-8. Rows with an inventory number already in the registry are skipped.

svc.name: Name
svc.pauseWaiting: Waiting for the requester stops the SLA timer
svc.vipBump: VIP employees' tickets get one priority step higher
svc.remindDays: Remind the requester after, working days
svc.remindHint: When the ticket waits for their reply. 0 — no reminder.
svc.resolveDays: Resolve without reply after another, working days
svc.resolveDaysHint: After the reminder; close code “No response”. 0 — never.
svc.matrixHint: Engineers set impact and urgency; priority is computed.
svc.closeCodesHint: Engineers pick a code when resolving. “No response” and “Duplicate” are set by the system.
svc.label: Label
svc.noCalendars: No calendars — the general schedule from ticket settings applies.
svc.specialHint: No time — day off; with time — working day with these hours (moved or short day).
svc.importHint: CSV “date;start;end;note” or an ICS file (paste its content here).
svc.siteCalendarsHint: SLA targets count in the working time of the ticket's site.
svc.noPolicies: No policies — targets are not tracked.
svc.policyHint: The most specific matching policy wins: site, category and priority. An empty field matches anything.
svc.workMinutesHint: Working minutes. 480 is one working day.
svc.autoAssign: Assign the group's tickets to the least loaded member
svc.conditionsHint: No conditions — every ticket. Comparison ignores case.
svc.scheduleHint: Local time of the site. Custom — a cron expression: “0 9 1 * *” is the 1st at 9:00.
svc.requesterHint: Empty — the ticket comes from the system.
svc.tokenHint: Read-only: reports, tickets, directory for BI and scripts. A token only gets permissions you have.
svc.tokenOnce: Copy the token now — it will not be shown again.
svc.tokenUsage: Request header “Authorization: Bearer pult_…”. Only read requests (GET) are allowed.
svc.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token? Scripts using it will stop working.
svc.webhookUrlHint: https only. Pult sends a JSON POST on ticket events.
svc.eventsHint: Comma separated: created, status, assigned, comment… Empty — all.
svc.secretHint: At least 16 characters. Signature header X-Pult-Signature: sha256=HMAC of the body.
svc.webhookUsage: Delivery is retried on errors. Verify X-Pult-Signature on your side.
svc.vipHint: Executives and key staff: their tickets get one priority step higher (setting above) and a VIP mark in the card. Search for a person to add.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.usage: Zabbix, Prometheus Alertmanager and other systems send alerts to /api/helpdesk/monitoring/alerts with the source token. A new alert notifies superadmins and, if enabled, opens a ticket; “resolved” is noted in the ticket feed.
monitoring.tokenOnce: The token is shown only once — save it in your monitoring system settings.
monitoring.generic: Zabbix (“Webhook” media type) and other systems — JSON:
monitoring.deleteConfirm: Delete the source together with its alerts? Tickets will remain.

formatHint.pult: POST with the ticket JSON and an X-Pult-Signature header — for your own services and automation.
formatHint.chat: A short channel message: event, number, subject, status and link. Comment texts are not sent.
formatHint.telegram: A bot message to a group or channel: event, number, subject, status and link. Add the bot to the chat first.

svc.chatUrlHint: Incoming webhook URL from the channel settings (Mattermost: Integrations → Incoming Webhooks).
svc.chatIdHint: Numeric group id (e.g. -1001234567890) or a public @channel name.

directory.sure: I checked that this is the right account

settings.dns: Enroll an agent only if the PC address matches DNS
settings.dnsHint: Prevents enrolling a foreign PC under the name of an AD computer.
settings.online: PC is online if it reported within, min
settings.dnsOff: Without the check anyone with the token can enroll their own PC under an AD computer name and fake its sessions. Turn it off only temporarily, if Pult sits behind a proxy.

tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke token “{{name}}”? New PCs will no longer enrol with it.

tokens.hint: The token goes to the MSI (ENROLLTOKEN) or a group policy. Only PCs present in AD can enroll.
tokens.name: Name

policies.hint: PC name, DNS name or a pattern with '*'. 'Forbidden' blocks every connection; 'Consent required' always prompts the user, even with control rights.
policies.badFile: The file does not look like policy.json.

packages.rolloutConfirm: Roll out update {{version}} to all agents? PCs install it at their next check.

packages.hint: The agent MSI is for GPO, the helper is for engineers. An agent update is accepted only if its signature matches the key set at install.
packages.signatureHint: The signing key stays offline and is never uploaded.

devices.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? The PC stops sending reports and remote help is unavailable.
devices.title: PCs with the agent
devices.hint: A deactivated PC sends no reports and cannot enroll again until it is activated.

org.wizardText: A few steps to fit the portal to your organization. You can skip any step and change it later in Settings → System.
org.languageHint: Default language for new users and emails. Starter categories, templates and equipment types are translated into it.
org.name: Organization name
org.nameHint: Shown in the portal header and on the sign-in page. You can leave it empty.
org.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 256 KB.
org.logoTooBig: The file is larger than 256 KB.

moduleAbout.helpdesk: Employee requests, ticket queue for engineers, knowledge base, equipment, reports.
moduleAbout.phonebook: Employee directory from AD with phones, departments and sites.
moduleAbout.directory: Enable accounts, manage groups and reset passwords from the portal, with approval and audit.
moduleAbout.remote: Agent on PCs: computer list and connecting to the user's session.
moduleAbout.telephony: Call log and click-to-call from the directory through the PBX.
moduleAbout.chat: Direct messages and group chats for employees. Only participants can read conversations.

org.telephonyNeedsPhonebook: Works only together with the directory.
org.sitesText: Sites are offices and branches: address, time zone, emergency phone, responsible engineers. You can add them later.
org.categoriesText: Categories an employee picks when creating a request. Rename, add or disable the ones you don't need.
org.mailText: Email for notifications. The portal works without it, but no emails are sent. You can set it up later.
org.doneText: The basics are set. Next: give the Engineer role to the right people (Users), set up SLA and templates in request settings.

profile.title: My profile
profile.cardHint: This is how colleagues see you. The data comes from AD and the directory; a directory editor or IT can change it.
profile.noCard: Your account is not linked to a directory card.
profile.sessionsHint: Where you are signed in. End any session you don't recognize and change your Windows password.
profile.totpHint: Optional: outside the organization's network the portal also asks for a code from an app on your phone. Even if your password leaks, nobody can sign in from outside without your phone.
profile.totpInsideOnly: You can turn this on or off only from the organization's network.

profile.totpStep2: Add an account using this setup key (manual entry):
profile.totpOpenApp: Open in the app (on the phone)
profile.totpStep3: Enter the 6 digits the app shows.
profile.totpOffText: Off: from the internet you sign in with your password, as in the office.
profile.totpRequired: Your role requires a code to sign in from the internet: until you set it up, sign-in from outside is not possible.
profile.totpOn: Code for sign-in from the internet is on
profile.totpOff: Code for sign-in from the internet is off
profile.passwordHint: The same password you use for your computer and mail. Password rules are set by the domain.
profile.passwordDone_one: Password changed. {{count}} session on other devices was closed.
profile.passwordDone_other: Password changed. {{count}} sessions on other devices were closed.

desk.emptyFilteredHint: Change the filters or open the “All” tab.
desk.emptyHint: New requests show up here automatically — the list refreshes every minute.

about.problem: Causes of recurring incidents: linked incidents, the cause and a workaround.
about.change: Planned infrastructure work: plan, rollback, window and approval.

itil.title: Subject
itil.workaroundHint: What to do until the cause is fixed: engineers see it in linked incidents.
itil.markKnown: Known error: the cause is found and a workaround exists
itil.resolveAllHint: Each incident is resolved with this reply; requesters get it by email and confirm the resolution.
itil.resolveFailed: Could not resolve: {{list}}. Open them and resolve manually.
itil.fromIncident: Open a problem from this ticket
itil.editResets: Editing the plan, rollback, window or risk restarts the approval.
itil.planHint: What is done, step by step, and how to check the result.
itil.rollbackHint: How to restore the previous state if something goes wrong. Required for medium and high risk.
itil.rulesHint: Who approves changes: by category and from a risk level. All matching rules apply; if none matches, the change is approved at once. Authors cannot approve their own changes.
itil.noRulesHint: Without rules, every change is approved as soon as it is submitted.

vault.title: Secrets vault
vault.subtitle: Service account passwords and keys. Each secret is open only to those it was shared with.
vault.emptyHint: Create a secret: you become its manager and decide who it is shared with.
vault.name: Name
vault.descriptionHint: Do not put passwords here: the description is visible to everyone who can see the card.
vault.valueHint: Stored in the database only in encrypted form.
vault.newValueHint: Leave empty to keep the current one.
vault.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log together with the view.
vault.noReveal: You can see only the secret card, not its value.
vault.deleteConfirm: Delete secret “{{name}}”? The value will be lost.
vault.accessHint: Access is granted to an employee or a portal role. “Card”: name and login are visible; “Value”: the secret itself too; “Manage”: editing, deletion and access.

assist.title: AI assistant
assist.subtitle: Answers from the knowledge base. The conversation is not saved: it is gone when you close the page.
assist.empty: Ask how to solve a task, for example "how to connect to VPN from home". The assistant answers from knowledge base articles and links to them.
assist.question: Your question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
assist.disclaimer: The assistant can be wrong and does nothing by itself. Do not send it passwords.
assist.off: The AI assistant is turned off. A superadministrator turns it on in Settings → System → AI assistant.
assist.noCategory: No suitable category found: choose one yourself.
assist.wait: An answer may take more than a minute if the model server has no GPU.

cmdb.suggestedHint: Items with the same responsible person or in the same room. A relation appears only after you add it.
cmdb.mapLegend: Solid arrow: a relation with impact; dashed: without impact. Items within two steps are shown.
cmdb.lifecycleLater: The lifecycle can be set up after the type is created.
cmdb.transitionsHint: Check the allowed transitions. Nothing checked means any transition is allowed. “In stock → in use” and “in use → in stock” are needed for issue and return.
cmdb.licensesHint: Installations are counted from the programs reported by the PC agents.
cmdb.patternHint: As in “Programs and Features”; case does not matter.
cmdb.deleteLicense: Delete the license? Programs on PCs are not affected.
cmdb.notInstalled: The agents have not found this program on any PC.
cmdb.impactFlagHint: A failure of the other item affects the first one: the relation is used in impact analysis.
cmdb.showStatusHint: Items of this type appear on the engineer home page with a state based on alerts: their own and those of what they depend on.

netbox.summary: Found in NetBox and not in the catalog: {{n}}
netbox.title: NetBox
netbox.hint: Network equipment, servers and virtual machines from NetBox. The portal only reads NetBox; found items enter the catalog after an engineer reviews them in “Equipment”, and accepted cards are not changed automatically afterwards.
netbox.tokenHint: A read-only token. It is stored encrypted and never shown.

chat.searchPeople: Find an employee: name or login
chat.nobody: Nobody found. You can message employees who have signed in to the portal at least once.
chat.title: Title
chat.groupHint: You will be the owner. Added people see the chat and its whole history right away and get a notification.
chat.lockedHint: A new owner is being assigned. You will be notified when the chat opens again.
chat.readOnlyHint: You left the chat: the history up to that point is read-only.
chat.emptyHint: Start a direct message or create a group chat with “New”.
chat.pick: Pick a chat on the left.
chat.placeholder: Message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.editing: Editing a message (possible for 15 minutes after sending)
chat.addHint: Added immediately, without an invitation; they get a notification.

actions.blocked: left: the AD account is disabled

chat.ownerHint: The owner cannot leave: a superadministrator transfers ownership.
chat.attachHint: Attach a file. You can also paste an image or drop files here.
chat.tooManyFiles: No more than {{count}} files per message

people.removeAvatarConfirm: Remove this employee's avatar? The action is recorded in the audit log.

profile.title: Profile for colleagues
profile.hint: Your avatar, about text and wall are shown to colleagues on your page.
profile.aboutHint: What you do and what people can ask you about. Up to 1000 characters.
profile.badImage: Couldn't read the image. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF will do.
profile.tooLarge: The image is too large even after compression.
profile.gifTooLarge: The GIF is larger than 15 MB.
profile.avatarHint: Photos are cropped to a square and shrunk. A GIF up to 15 MB keeps its animation — the server shrinks it.

wall.title: Wall
wall.offHint: This employee has turned the wall off.
wall.mode: Who can post on my wall

feed.title: Feed
feed.hint: Posts from colleagues' walls. New ones appear on their own.
feed.empty: No posts yet. Write the first one!

chatAdmin.hint: Group chats without messages: an administrator cannot read conversations, and direct messages are not listed here. Assigning an owner (including yourself) is recorded in the audit log.
chatAdmin.assignHint: Ownership transfers immediately, without consent. A locked chat opens and its members are notified.
chatAdmin.statsHint: Only portal-wide totals, without people, departments or chats. Values below 5 are not shown.

extensions.hint: An extension is an external service with a pult-extension.json manifest. The portal gives it a read-only API token with the rights from the manifest, a signed webhook for ticket events and menu links. Extension code never runs inside the portal.
extensions.badFile: The file is not valid JSON.
extensions.catalogHint: A JSON array of manifests over https. Empty means no catalog.
extensions.willRead: Will be able to read through the API
extensions.noApi: Does not ask for API access.
extensions.responsibility: By installing an extension, the organization trusts its publisher with the data it gets access to.
extensions.alreadyInstalled: Already installed. To update, remove it and install again.
extensions.secretsHint: Copy them into the extension settings now: they are not shown again.
extensions.nothingToShow: The extension needs neither a token nor a webhook.
extensions.confirmDelete: Remove the extension “{{name}}”? Its token is revoked and the webhook deleted.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.hint: Portal notifications arrive even when the tab is closed. On a phone, first install the portal to the home screen (browser menu → Install app or Add to Home Screen).
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications, or the portal is not opened over HTTPS.
push.unavailable: Device notifications are turned off by the administrator.
push.denied: The browser did not allow notifications. Allow them in the site settings and try again.

catalog.title: Service catalog
catalog.hint: Choose what you need help with: a request with the right fields opens. Not listed? Create a request and describe it in your own words.
